commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90+4' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Joselu (Real Madrid) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
88' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
81' 0 - 1 GOAL! The corner comes over and Joselu wins a simple header before Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) nods the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
81' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
81' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch because Luca de la Torre simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
80' Here is a change. Fran Garcia is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid).
80' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) for Jorgen Strand Larsen.
75' Wasted effort! Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) received a nice pass in space from Jude Bellingham, but his long-range shot was weak and floated well wide of the right post.

72' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
71' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz de Mera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) missed a big chance! He produces a stunning volley from inside the box, but his effort goes not far wide of the right post.
69' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the left post, but Ivan Villar leaps out to thwart his attempt.
68' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
67' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
66' Ivan Villar (Celta Vigo) jumps into a tackle and Isidro Diaz de Mera signals a foul. The referee gives a penalty kick to Real Madrid!!
66' One of the players from Real Madrid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
64' What a big chance! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
62' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Jude Bellingham and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
62' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Aurelien Tchouameni is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
62' Substitution. Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Eduardo Camavinga walks off.
58' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
56' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
54' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Villar intercepts the ball.
52' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) latches on to a cross inside the box and heads the ball towards the right post, but it's an easy save for the keeper.
52' The attendance is 23057.
52' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Rodrygo. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
51' None of the Real Madrid players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
50' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
46' The whistle blows and Isidro Diaz de Mera starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Rafael Benitez is forced to make a change. Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Manu Sanchez.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
43' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Joselu (Real Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
39' The corner from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
38' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Real Madrid get a corner.
37' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
35' The ball is crossed into the box and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the top left corner, but Kepa Arrizabalaga gets a glove on it to thwart him.
34' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.

33' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) gets inside the box and tries to beat Kepa Arrizabalaga with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
33' A cross into the box picks out Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
30' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the left post.
29' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
27' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Joselu, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
24' Celta Vigo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
23' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Celta Vigo earn a corner.
21' A spell of possession for Real Madrid in an attempt to control the game.
18' Carlo Ancelotti is forced to make a change. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is unable to continue due to injury, Joselu comes on.
18' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
17' It doesn’t look good for Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid); looks like he’ll be heading for an early bath!
15' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
10' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
10' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
8' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
6' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
6' Celebrations are cut short for Celta Vigo as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
5' Wait! Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera has indicated he is going to review the Celta Vigo goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
3' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' What a hit! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
2' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
